:- pred use/2, gloss('use of an AI system by a deployer'), source('art_5').
:- pred harmful_subliminal_manipulative/1, gloss('AI system deploys subliminal or manipulative techniques that materially distort behaviour and cause significant harm'), source('art_5').
:- pred exploits_vulnerability/1, gloss('AI system exploits vulnerabilities linked to age, disability or specific social/economic situation, causing significant harm'), source('art_5').
:- pred social_scoring_system/1, gloss('AI system evaluates or classifies persons over time based on social behaviour or inferred characteristics, leading to unfavourable treatment'), source('art_5').
:- pred leads_to_unfavourable_treatment/1, gloss('The social score leads to detrimental or disproportionate treatment'), source('art_5').
:- pred risk_assessment_criminal_offence/1, gloss('AI system makes risk assessments of persons for committing a criminal offence based solely on profiling'), source('art_5').
:- pred permitted_support_human_assessment/1, gloss('AI system is used only to support human assessment based on objective, verifiable facts'), source('art_5').
:- pred untargeted_scraping_facial_database/1, gloss('AI system creates or expands facial recognition databases by untargeted scraping of images or CCTV footage'), source('art_5').
:- pred emotion_inference_workplace_education/1, gloss('AI system infers emotions of persons in workplace or education contexts'), source('art_5').
:- pred medical_or_safety_intended/1, gloss('The system is intended for medical or safety reasons'), source('art_5').
:- pred biometric_categorisation_protected_attributes/1, gloss('Biometric categorisation system deduces protected attributes such as race, political opinion, etc.'), source('art_5').
:- pred law_enforcement_labeling/1, gloss('Labelling or filtering of lawfully acquired biometric datasets for law‑enforcement purposes'), source('art_5').
:- pred law_enforcement_use/1, gloss('Use of an AI system for law‑enforcement purposes'), source('art_5').
:- pred allowed_objective/1, gloss('Objective that may justify the use of real‑time remote biometric identification'), source('art_5').
:- pred use_objective/2, gloss('The use of a system is for a given objective'), source('art_5').
:- pred specific_targeted_individual/1, gloss('The system is used to confirm the identity of a specifically targeted individual'), source('art_5').
:- pred authorisation_granted/1, gloss('Prior authorisation by a judicial or independent administrative authority has been granted'), source('art_5').
:- pred urgent_use/1, gloss('Use is undertaken in a duly justified situation of urgency'), source('art_5').
:- pred authorisation_requested/1, gloss('Authorisation has been requested without undue delay'), source('art_5').

% --- Prohibited AI practices (a) to (g) -----------------------------------------

prohibited_ai_system(System) :-
    ai_system(System),
    harmful_subliminal_manipulative(System).

prohibited_ai_system(System) :-
    ai_system(System),
    exploits_vulnerability(System).

prohibited_ai_system(System) :-
    ai_system(System),
    social_scoring_system(System),
    leads_to_unfavourable_treatment(System).

prohibited_ai_system(System) :-
    ai_system(System),
    risk_assessment_criminal_offence(System),
    \+ permitted_support_human_assessment(System).

prohibited_ai_system(System) :-
    ai_system(System),
    untargeted_scraping_facial_database(System).

prohibited_ai_system(System) :-
    ai_system(System),
    emotion_inference_workplace_education(System),
    \+ medical_or_safety_intended(System).

prohibited_ai_system(System) :-
    ai_system(System),
    biometric_categorisation_protected_attributes(System),
    \+ law_enforcement_labeling(System).

% The prohibition applies to placing on the market, putting into service, or use
prohibited_action(placing_on_market, Provider, System) :-
    placing_on_market(Provider, System),
    prohibited_ai_system(System).

prohibited_action(putting_into_service, Provider, System) :-
    putting_into_service(Provider, System),
    prohibited_ai_system(System).

prohibited_action(use, Deployer, System) :-
    use(Deployer, System),
    prohibited_ai_system(System).

% --- Prohibited use of real‑time remote biometric identification (h) ---------

% Allowed objectives (i)–(iii) as per the provision
allowed_objective(targeted_search_victims).
allowed_objective(prevention_imminent_threat).
allowed_objective(localisation_of_suspect).

% A use is permitted if it meets an allowed objective, has prior authorisation,
% and is limited to confirming the identity of a specifically targeted individual
permitted_rrbis_use(Provider, System) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(System),
    publicly_accessible_space(_),
    law_enforcement_use(Provider),
    use_objective(System, Objective),
    allowed_objective(Objective),
    authorisation_granted(System),
    specific_targeted_individual(System).

% Urgent exception: may be commenced without prior authorisation if
% authorisation is requested without undue delay
permitted_rrbis_use(Provider, System) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(System),
    publicly_accessible_space(_),
    law_enforcement_use(Provider),
    urgent_use(System),
    authorisation_requested(System).

% Prohibition unless one of the permitted cases applies
prohibited_rrbis_use(Provider, System) :-
    real_time_remote_biometric_identification_system(System),
    publicly_accessible_space(_),
    law_enforcement_use(Provider),
    \+ permitted_rrbis_use(Provider, System).

% --- Provenance --------------------------------------------------------------
